snapshot.title: UPSC REVISION: Science & Technology (Days 92–96)
snapshot.exam_hook: 🏆 UPSC VICTORY HOOK: S&T complete. High speed drill of apps. NavIC, CRISPR, Web3, Nano, Nuclear. Consolidate and conquer.

quick_notes.title: Space Tech Recap
quick_notes.detail: Launchers: PSLV, GSLV (Cryo), LVM3. NavIC (7 sats). Missions : Chandrayaan, Gaganyaan, Aditya-L1.
quick_notes.explanation: Space Tech Recap. India's space program uses different types of rockets called launchers. The Polar Satellite Launch Vehicle (PSLV) is a reliable rocket for putting satellites into polar orbits. The Geosynchronous Satellite Launch Vehicle (GSLV) uses a cryogenic engine, which burns very cold liquid fuel, to place heavier satellites into higher, geosynchronous orbits. The Launch Vehicle Mark 3 (LVM3) is India's most powerful rocket, capable of launching large payloads like the Chandrayaan missions. Navigation with Indian Constellation (NavIC) is India's own satellite navigation system, consisting of 7 satellites in space to provide positioning services. Key Indian space missions include Chandrayaan (lunar exploration), Gaganyaan (human spaceflight program to send astronauts into orbit), and Aditya-L1 (a solar observation mission that will study the Sun from a point called Lagrange point 1).

quick_notes.title: Biotech Recap
quick_notes.detail: Gene editing: CRISPR. Vaccines : mRNA, DNA (ZyCoV-D). 3-Parent Baby (Mito). GM Crops (BT Cotton).
quick_notes.explanation: CRISPR is a gene editing tool that allows scientists to cut and modify DNA, the genetic material inside cells, to change how living things work. mRNA vaccines, like those for COVID-19, use a molecule called messenger RNA to instruct your cells to produce a harmless piece of a virus, which trains your immune system to fight the real virus. DNA vaccines, such as ZyCoV-D, work by injecting a small circle of DNA that makes your cells produce an antigen, triggering an immune response. A three-parent baby is created through a technique called mitochondrial replacement therapy, where DNA from a mother, father, and a donor woman is combined to prevent inherited diseases caused by faulty mitochondria, the energy-producing parts of cells. Genetically modified crops, or GM crops, like Bt cotton, have had their genes changed so the plant produces a protein that is toxic to certain insect pests, reducing the need for chemical pesticides.

quick_notes.title: IT/AI Recap
quick_notes.detail: Generative AI (LLMs). Web3 (Blockchain). Quantum (Qubits). 5G/6G. Edge computing.
quick_notes.explanation: Generative AI is a type of artificial intelligence that can create new content, like text, images, or music, by learning patterns from existing data; it is often powered by Large Language Models (LLMs), which are AI systems trained on huge amounts of text to understand and generate human-like language. Web3 is a concept for a new version of the internet built on blockchain technology, which is a decentralized digital ledger where information is recorded in linked blocks that cannot be easily changed, giving users more control over their data and transactions. Quantum computing uses quantum bits, or qubits, which can exist in multiple states at once (unlike regular computer bits that are either 0 or 1), allowing them to solve certain complex problems much faster than traditional computers. 5G and 6G are the fifth and sixth generations of mobile network technology; 5G offers faster speeds and lower delays than 4G, while 6G is expected to be even faster and support new applications like holographic communication. Edge computing is a method of processing data closer to where it is generated (like on a local device or nearby server) instead of sending it all to a distant central data center, which reduces delays and saves bandwidth.

quick_notes.title: Nano & Materials Recap
quick_notes.detail: Graphene (2D Carbon). Nano-urea (Liquid). Targeted drug delivery.
quick_notes.explanation: Graphene is a material made of carbon atoms arranged in a single layer, only one atom thick, so it is called a two-dimensional (2D) form of carbon. Nano-urea is a liquid fertilizer that contains very tiny particles of urea, which makes it more efficient for plants to absorb compared to regular solid urea. Targeted drug delivery is a medical technique where medicine is carried in tiny particles called nanoparticles directly to the diseased cells in the body, reducing side effects on healthy cells. These are examples of how nanotechnology (the science of very small things) is used in agriculture and medicine.

quick_notes.title: Nuclear Recap
quick_notes.detail: 3-Stages (Thorium). Fission, whereas Fusion (ITER). LIGO (Gravitational waves). Higgs Boson.
quick_notes.explanation: India's nuclear power program has three stages, with the final stage using thorium, a naturally abundant radioactive element, as fuel. Nuclear fission is the splitting of a heavy atom's nucleus to release energy, used in current reactors, while nuclear fusion is the combining of light atomic nuclei to release even more energy, and ITER is an international experimental fusion reactor being built to test this process. LIGO, which stands for Laser Interferometer Gravitational-Wave Observatory, is a facility that detects gravitational waves—ripples in space-time caused by massive cosmic events like black hole collisions. The Higgs boson is a subatomic particle that gives other particles their mass through the Higgs field, and its discovery confirmed a key part of the Standard Model of particle physics.

lesson_intro: Today we wrap up 'Science & Technology'. You have traveled from the depths of the atom to the edges of the universe. S&T is the 'Application-based' pillar of UPSC—it rewards curiosity and awareness of modern trends. Today, we consolidate the tech. Can you explain NavIC? CRISPR? Web3? 3-Stage Nuclear? Let's master the technology that is building the future.
